summary: Iter 79 backend verification — 14/14 pytest PASS across the 4 target test files (test_iter79_wizard_expansion.py, test_league_settings_enforcement.py, test_league_update_full.py, test_setup_wizard.py). All new wizard fields (salary_retention_*, season_start_date/end_date, matchup_length_days, opponents_per_matchup_period, playoff_end_week, consolation_*) round-trip via PUT/GET. validate-setup returns ok=True for the seeded Ice Kings league (LID 69e46af167999bfb85c39628). generate-schedule produces clear 403 'commissioner' message for non-commissioner caller. Trade-deadline enforcement still blocks proposals when current_week > trade_deadline_week with 'deadline' in the 400 detail. Waiver processes_at = created_at + waiver_period_days * 24h verified to ±60s. Setup-wizard complete/reset endpoints flip the flag and are commissioner-only (403 for stranger). Audit-log diff on PUT /leagues only writes changed fields. 422 validation enforced for out-of-range roster_spots (<10) and trade_veto_threshold_pct (>100).
critical_code_review_comments: matchups.py generate_schedule (line 160-162) correctly falls back to league.regular_season_weeks when num_weeks is omitted; final fallback to 18 only if league field is missing — matches spec.

matchups.py line 149 emits 'Need at least 2 teams to generate a schedule — this league has N team(s)' for teams<2 — human-readable, matches spec (not exercised by a live request because the seed league has 12 teams; verified statically).

test_setup_wizard.py requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be set as an env var (os.environ['REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL']) — runners must export it from frontend/.env or the collection fails. Other three files self-load it from frontend/.env. Recommend aligning to the same loader for robustness (non-blocking).
test_trade_deadline_blocks_new_proposals correctly snapshots/restores trade_deadline_week + current_week, leaving seed clean.
seed_data_creation: None — all mutating tests snapshot/restore. A short-lived stranger user (wiz_stranger_<hex>) is registered for the commissioner-only test (idempotent, no cleanup needed).
